about: Rehaan Computers provides practical computer education with individual attention, modern facilities and job-oriented learning. Every student works on their own system and practises real documents, real accounts and real designs.
Our goal is simple: learn the basics, practise real work, build confidence and grow your skills — at your own pace, with no pressure of a fixed admission deadline.

benefits.title: Practical Training
benefits.text: Learn by actually working on computers with real tasks, not just theory and notes.

benefits.title: Expert Guidance
benefits.text: Get continuous guidance from experienced instructors throughout your course.

benefits.title: Individual Attention
benefits.text: A personal system and paced teaching, so no learner is left behind.

benefits.title: Professional Certificate
benefits.text: Receive a verifiable course certificate after completing your training.

steps.title: Choose a Course
steps.text: Pick the course and the Morning, Afternoon or Evening batch that suits your schedule.

steps.title: Submit the Form
steps.text: Fill in the online application below — you will receive a confirmation by email.

steps.title: Visit the Centre
steps.text: Bring 2 passport-size photographs and a photocopy of your Aadhaar card.

steps.title: Start Learning
steps.text: Pay the ₹100 admission fee, your seat is confirmed and practical training starts in your chosen batch.

faq.q: Is my admission complete after I submit the form?
faq.a: No. The form registers your application. You must visit the centre with 2 passport-size photographs and a photocopy of your Aadhaar card to complete your admission.

faq.q: Is there a last date for admission?
faq.a: No. Online admission stays open all year — there is no last date. A one-time ₹100 admission fee blocks your seat, allotted in the order applications arrive.
As soon as your admission is confirmed — pay the ₹100 admission fee, complete document verification at the centre, and join the next Morning, Afternoon or Evening batch.

faq.q: Why is there a ₹100 admission fee?
faq.a: The ₹100 one-time admission fee reserves your seat and covers registration. Course fees are paid separately at the centre — the admission fee is not an advance or EMI.

faq.q: What documents do I need to bring?
faq.a: Two passport-size photographs and one photocopy of your Aadhaar card. Carry them when you visit the centre after applying online.

faq.q: How can I check course fees?
faq.a: Contact or visit Rehaan Computers for current course tuition details. The separate one-time admission fee is ₹100.
You can choose a Morning, Afternoon or Evening batch in the application form. Batches begin right after your admission is confirmed.

tools.title: MS Excel
tools.text: Formulas, VLOOKUP, pivot tables, charts and ready-to-use payroll and billing sheets built from scratch.

tools.title: Tally Prime
tools.text: Company creation, vouchers, GST invoices, inventory and final accounts — practised on the live Tally Prime screen.

tools.title: Web & Code
tools.text: HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Python basics — you build and run real projects, not pretend ones.

tools.title: MS Word
tools.text: Formatting, mail merge, tables and print-ready assignments, CVs and project files — typed from day one.

batches.title: Morning Batch
batches.text: Ideal for school and college students who attend regular classes in the afternoon.

batches.title: Afternoon Batch
batches.text: Perfect for learners who prefer a relaxed mid-day schedule after lunch.

batches.title: Evening Batch
batches.text: Designed for working learners and business users after shop and office hours.
